title: The Liturgical Calendar
content: The traditional Roman calendar is structured around two overlapping cycles: the Temporal cycle (Temporale), which centers on the life of Christ and the seasons of the year, and the Sanctoral cycle (Sanctorale), which commemorates the saints.

title: The Sacraments
content: The seven sacraments instituted by Christ are Baptism, Confirmation, Holy Eucharist, Penance, Extreme Unction, Holy Orders, and Matrimony.
